title: The Lantern Moth
statement: Long ago the night sky had no wandering things in it, only patient stars, until a small moth mistook the faintest star for a lamp left on in a distant window and flew toward it for a thousand years. Each autumn she is seen again with her wings tracing outward in thin silver lines, and the star she is chasing grows slightly brighter, as if someone, somewhere, were finally answering.
